USD.note: Fed funds 3.75 to 4.00% after a 25bp hike on 16 Sep. Hold expected 28 Oct, December hike priced near 94%. CPI 3.7%, core 2.6%. September payrolls +29k, unemployment 4.2%.

EUR.note: Deposit rate 2.50% after a 25bp hike in September. Hold on 29 Oct expected by 70 of 73 economists, December hike by 64 of 73. Flash HICP 3.8%, core 2.5%, highest since Sep 2023.

GBP.note: Bank Rate 3.75%. September hold was 6 to 3, three votes for a hike. A 5 Nov hike is priced as near certain, about four hikes by mid-2027. Regular pay +3.7%, unemployment 4.7%.

JPY.note: Policy rate 1.25% after a 25bp hike in September (7 to 2 vote). October hike under 5% priced, December about 80%. Real rate stays deeply negative.

CHF.note: SNB held 0% on 24 Sep, the fifth hold. Willing to act in FX as necessary. Next meeting 10 Dec. CPI 1.0%. Surveys see no hike before 2027 or 2028.

AUD.note: Cash rate 4.60% after a hike on 30 Sep, a 15-year high. September unemployment 4.7%, a five-year high, employment down about 40k. Hold expected 3 Nov, risk still leans to a hike.

NZD.note: OCR 2.75%. A 25bp hike to 3.00% on 28 Oct is priced near 80%. BNZ sees a 3.75% peak. Q3 CPI 3.7% y/y against 4.1% in Q2.

CAD.note: Overnight rate 2.25%, unchanged since Oct 2025. Hold expected 28 Oct. CPI 3.1%, below the 3.2% consensus. Jobs fell in August and September.
